verdict.rationale: Increase documents ACH origination through `POST /ach_transfers`, same-day ACH debits, and submission at every Fed window. Returns are tracked and correlated with their originating transfers, and webhooks fire for each lifecycle step. Most of the depth comes from solution pages and customer stories rather than API reference docs, and NOCs and reversals are never mentioned. missing for 10: evidence of NOCs (notifications of change) as first-class objects, evidence of reversals, API-reference-level documentation of return objects and their webhook event types, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can originate ACH through the API — credits and debits, same-day windows, and the unhappy paths (returns, NOCs, reversals) modeled as first-class objects with webhooks

citations.quote: You make a `POST /ach_transfers` call with the details of how much you'd like to send and data about the recipient.
Use our advanced ACH integration to directly debit your customers’ accounts with same-day settlement.
We offer same-day ACH, submit at every Fed window, and provide robust settlement tracking.
submit bill payments to the Federal Reserve through all 3 same-day ACH windows, and ingest webhooks for each step in the transfer life-cycle
With ACH and Check returns automatically correlated with their originating transfers, it’s simple to track and resolve exceptions.
